papers.title: Microstructure–property evaluation and equiaxed regulation of novel Ti-6Al-4V-2Cr-xMo alloys fabricated by directed energy deposition
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Material Science and Engineering, Chang’an University, Xi’an, Shaanxi 710064, PR China

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Material Science and Engineering, Chang’an University, Xi’an, Shaanxi 710064, PR China

corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Solidification Processing, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi’an, Shaanxi 710072, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是添加Cr和Mo的Ti-6Al-4V改性合金，并非标准Ti-6Al-4V，因此与层1方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies a novel alloy Ti-6Al-4V-2Cr-xMo, not the standard Ti-6Al-4V composition, thus falling outside the mandatory scope for Layer 1.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索新型Ti-6Al-4V-2Cr-xMo合金的微观结构与性能关系。
summary_zh.method: 采用定向能量沉积制备不同Mo含量的合金，并进行微观组织表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 研究了Cr和Mo添加对组织等轴化和性能的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 进行了微观结构和力学性能实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the microstructure-property relationship and equiaxed regulation of novel Ti-6Al-4V-2Cr-xMo alloys fabricated by directed energy deposition.
summary_en.method: The study utilizes directed energy deposition to fabricate alloys with varying Mo content, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The effect of Cr and Mo additions on equiaxed grain formation and mechanical properties was investigated.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.

papers.title: Synergistic effects of reinforcement and matrix powder sizes on microstructure and mechanical properties of spark plasma sintered TiB/Ti-6Al-4V composites
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory for Liquid-Solid Structural Evolution and Processing of Materials (Ministry of Education), Shandong University, Jinan, Shandong 250061, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: J.E. Tang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory for Liquid-Solid Structural Evolution and Processing of Materials (Ministry of Education), Shandong University, Jinan, Shandong 250061, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Chen Liang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory for Liquid-Solid Structural Evolution and Processing of Materials (Ministry of Education), Shandong University, Jinan, Shandong 250061, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用放电等离子烧结制备TiB/Ti-6Al-4V复合材料，而非增材制造（如LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED），不符合方向要求。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses spark plasma sintering (SPS) to fabricate TiB/Ti-6Al-4V composites, not additive manufacturing (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED) as required by the direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索增强相和基体粉末尺寸对SPS制备TiB/Ti-6Al-4V复合材料性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过改变TiB和Ti-6Al-4V粉末尺寸，采用放电等离子烧结制备复合材料
summary_zh.result: 发现粉末尺寸协同影响微观组织和力学性能，优化组合可提升强度与塑性
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微表征和拉伸/硬度测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the combined effects of reinforcement and matrix powder sizes on the microstructure and mechanical properties of TiB/Ti-6Al-4V composites fabricated by spark plasma sintering.
summary_en.method: Composite samples were prepared by spark plasma sintering with varied TiB and Ti-6Al-4V powder sizes.
summary_en.result: Synergistic effects of powder sizes on microstructure and mechanical properties were observed, with optimized combinations improving strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Validation via microstructural characterization and mechanical testing (tensile, hardness).
